name: get_overview
description: Summary of the open family tree: its name, the family lines (family names) with member counts, total people, and who the user is if known. Call this at the start of a conversation and whenever you need the big picture.

name: find_people
description: Search people already in the tree by name (first name, family name or both; partial or approximate spellings are fine). Returns person ids to use with the other tools. Always search before assuming someone does or doesn't exist.

query.description: A name as the user said it, e.g. 'Ravi' or 'Lakshmi Rao'.

name: get_person
description: Full details of one person plus their parents, partners, children and siblings (with ids).

name: how_related
description: How person A is related to person B: the English term, the Telugu kinship word (with romanised reading) and the chain of people linking them. For 'how is X related to me', use the user's own person id as person_b_id.

name: propose_add_person
description: Prepare adding a NEW person (does not save). Optionally link them to an existing relative. Returns a proposal_id, a one-sentence summary to read back, and missing_details still worth asking for. The proposal appears on the user's screen. Nothing is saved until confirm_proposal. Creating a new proposal replaces any unconfirmed one.

family_name.description: Surname / family name (the family line they appear in). Leave empty to use the relative's family name for child, parent or sibling.

died_year.description: Only if they have passed away.

notes.description: Anything else worth remembering: town, profession, nickname.

relation.description: What the NEW person is to relative_id. 'child' means the new person is a child of relative_id. Use 'none' only for the very first person or someone unconnected.

relative_id.description: Existing person the new person is related to.

other_parent_id.description: For relation=child: the relative's partner who is the other parent.

name: propose_update_person
description: Prepare changing details of someone already in the tree (does not save). Only pass the fields that change.

died_year.description: Use 0 to mark them as living again.

name: propose_link
description: Prepare connecting two people who are BOTH already in the tree (does not save), e.g. 'Ravi and Sita are married' or 'Anu is Ravi's daughter'.

name: propose_remove_person
description: Prepare removing someone from the tree (does not save). Always ask the user to confirm twice before confirming a removal.

name: confirm_proposal
description: Save a proposal. Only call after the user clearly said yes to the summary you read back.

name: cancel_proposal
description: Discard a proposal the user said no to.

name: set_me
description: Remember which person in the tree is the user (e.g. after 'I am Anil'). Needed to answer questions about 'me'.

name: show_on_screen
description: Move the visible tree to a person or a family line so the user can see who you mean.
